verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source framework with a hosted Pipecat Cloud, so a no-training data policy or opt-out control is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents no such policy or opt-out from Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud. Community notes that Pipecat can run local models (ollama, whisper) and the evidence that it is self-hostable describe user-side ways to keep data local, not a product capability that prevents training on user data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
